# v2.87-dev

Housekeeping release: the codebase now passes its own linter again, and CI will
keep it that way. No user-facing behaviour changes.

## Fixed

- **`npm run lint` passes again.** It had been failing with 44 errors and 1
  warning. Nothing ran it automatically — the release workflow only tagged
  releases, no deploy script called it, and Next 16's `next build` no longer
  runs ESLint — so the errors accumulated unnoticed. Every one is now fixed in
  the code; no rule was disabled or downgraded to get there.

  The errors came from the React Compiler rules in `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`.
  The code had been like this for a while; what surfaced it was the dependency
  refresh in v2.86 resolving the plugin from 7.0.1 to 7.1.1, which reports these
  patterns where the older build did not.

## Changed under the hood

- **Report pages now use the shared `useFetchJson` hook.** The eight
  server-paginated reports (By Product Type, By Function, Expiring Soon,
  Currently Expired, Achievement Over Time, Learner Scorecard, Legacy
  Replacement Gap, Trained But Not Certified) each carried an identical
  hand-rolled fetch effect. They now share the hook the rest of the app already
  uses, which derives the loading state instead of storing it. The Training
  catalogue, Students list, Offerings dashboard, Partner-program dashboard and
  the Backup file list moved to the same hook.

- **Two latent bugs fixed along the way.** The partner-program dashboard and the
  offering dashboard fetched without a cancellation guard, so a slow response
  for one scope could overwrite a newer one for another. Both now go through the
  shared hook, which guards against that.

- **Add/Edit dialogs are now created fresh each time they open** — the program
  requirement, program tier and offering requirement dialogs — instead of being
  kept mounted and reset by hand. Same behaviour, less that can go stale between
  openings.

- **Slightly better loading states.** Signing in and landing on a page now shows
  a loading state while your profile and company list load, rather than briefly
  rendering as though you were signed out. The partner-program dashboard shows a
  spinner during its first load instead of an empty report.

## Added

- **A CI workflow** (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs lint and typecheck on every
  push and pull request to `dev` and `master`, and the release workflow now runs
  the same two checks before it tags. A release can no longer be cut from a tree
  that does not lint or typecheck.
